address.en: WLSA Shanghai School, Baoshan, Shanghai, People's Republic of China
address.zh: 中国上海市宝山区 WLSA 上海学校

en: The KCVA Volleyball Tournament is a premier youth sports event co-hosted by KCVA and WLSA Shanghai Academy. This tournament aims to showcase the competitive spirit, teamwork, and athletic passion of youth students.
Hosted at WLSA Shanghai School in Baoshan, the tournament brings together high school volleyball squads for a full day of competitive match play.
Built around school teams, the event emphasizes sportsmanship, varsity pride, and a professional tournament environment for student-athletes, coaches, and campus communities.
Player and volunteer registration closes May 12, 2026, with ticket sales ending June 11, 2026. Tournament results will be published on June 14, 2026.
zh: KCVA 排球锦标赛是由 KCVA 与 WLSA 上海学校联合主办的高水平青少年体育赛事。本次赛事旨在展现青年学生的竞技精神、团队合作与运动热情。
赛事将在位于上海宝山的 WLSA 上海学校举行，汇聚多支高中排球校队，展开一整天的激烈角逐。
赛事以校队为核心，强调体育精神、母校荣誉与专业赛事体验，为学生运动员、教练与校园社群提供高水平的竞技舞台。
球员与志愿者报名将于 2026 年 5 月 12 日截止，售票将于 2026 年 6 月 11 日结束。赛事结果将于 2026 年 6 月 14 日公布。
